# Dubbing languages — exact list (generated by `backend/scripts/gen_language_doc.py` from `app/speech/catalog.py`)

Self-hosted only (no paid API, ₹0 per dub): Whisper speech-to-text → Argos translation → Kokoro/Piper voices. A language appears in the app only when every model on its path is pinned, downloaded and verified on the worker. Measured quality per language: `DUBBING_EVAL.md`.

## Source languages (45): what you can dub FROM

Detected automatically (or chosen by hand). Whisper recognises ~100 languages, but only these can be translated:

Arabic (`ar`), Azerbaijani (`az`), Bulgarian (`bg`), Bengali (`bn`), Catalan (`ca`), Czech (`cs`), Danish (`da`), German (`de`), Greek (`el`), English (`en`), Spanish (`es`), Estonian (`et`), Basque (`eu`), Persian (`fa`), Finnish (`fi`), French (`fr`), Galician (`gl`), Hebrew (`he`), Hindi (`hi`), Hungarian (`hu`), Indonesian (`id`), Italian (`it`), Japanese (`ja`), Korean (`ko`), Lithuanian (`lt`), Latvian (`lv`), Malay (`ms`), Norwegian Bokmål (`nb`), Dutch (`nl`), Polish (`pl`), Portuguese (`pt`), Romanian (`ro`), Russian (`ru`), Slovak (`sk`), Slovenian (`sl`), Albanian (`sq`), Swedish (`sv`), Swahili (`sw`), Thai (`th`), Tagalog (`tl`), Turkish (`tr`), Ukrainian (`uk`), Urdu (`ur`), Vietnamese (`vi`), Chinese (`zh`)

## Dialects and accents (as the voices actually speak)

- English: American (Heart, Michael, Nicole) and British (George, Emma). Speech recognition handles Indian English.
- Portuguese: Brazilian only (both voices are pt-BR; translation uses the Brazilian model).
- Spanish: Castilian-style voices (Kokoro); speech recognition handles Latin American Spanish (FLEURS es-419 WER 3.7%).
- Dutch: Netherlands (Pim) and Flemish (Nathalie). Norwegian: Bokmål.
- Hindi: standard Hindi voices. Spoken Hindi is often scored as Urdu by Whisper; the app folds Urdu into Hindi when Hindi has a real chance (`ASR_PREFER`, default `ur:hi:0.10`).

## Every source → target pair

45 × 26 = 1170 combinations, all routed. Pairs without English on one side go through English (two translation steps: expect lower quality). Same-language pairs only re-voice. The server reports the route of every pair at `GET /api/v1/dub/languages`.

## Mixed-language speech

The file's language is detected from up to six 15-second windows across the whole file (not just the start). Then **every sentence of ≥ 1.2 s gets its own language check**; if Whisper is ≥ 70 % sure it is another language, that sentence is re-recognised in its own language and marked. Translation works sentence by sentence from each sentence's real language; sentences already in the target language are kept. Users can correct any sentence's language (and the whole file's language) in the studio.

## Not available (and why)

| Languages | Why |
|---|---|
| Japanese, Chinese (as targets) | Kokoro voices failed the pronunciation check (judge CER 309 % and 60 %): kokoro-onnx's espeak phonemizer can't read them. Needs the misaki ja/zh phonemizer. Still available as **sources**. |
| Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Kannada, Gujarati, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia | No commercially usable free translation model in the pinned set (Whisper recognises their speech, but it can't be translated); Malayalam Piper voices have an unclear licence. Path: AI4Bharat IndicTrans2 (MIT) + Indic Parler-TTS (Apache-2.0), see FINE_TUNING_PLAN.md §2 |
| Bengali, Urdu, Arabic, Korean, Thai, Indonesian, Hebrew… (as targets) | Can be dubbed FROM, but no commercially licensed voice exists for them in Kokoro/Piper |
| Hindi Piper voices Pratham and Priyamvada | Licence CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial) — replaced by Kokoro Hindi voices (Apache-2.0) |
| English Piper voices Ryan, Lessac, Amy, HFC | Non-commercial or unclear licences — replaced by Kokoro English voices |
| Automatic speaker separation of overlapping speech | One speaker per sentence only; users can relabel any sentence |
| Removing the original voice under the dub | No source-separation model: the original track is lowered to 15 % during speech (`duck`, 0 = mute) |

## Disk and memory

All languages with Whisper small: **~8.7 GB** on the worker's model disk (`DUB_SOURCES` / `DUB_TARGETS` narrow it; Whisper medium adds 1.5 GB). Peak RAM while dubbing and timings: `DUBBING_EVAL.md`; models are released after each job.
